import subprocess, time, sys
cases = [(0, 0), (2, 0), (3, 1), (10, 4), (11, 4), (12, 5), (5000000, 348513), (50000000, 3001134)]
for n, exp in cases:
    out = int(subprocess.check_output(['python3', 'primes.py', str(n)]))
    if out != exp:
        print(0)
        sys.exit(1)
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(4):
    subprocess.check_output(['python3', 'primes.py', '5000000'])
    subprocess.check_output(['python3', 'primes.py', '50000000'])
dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
print(f'{100.0 / dt:.2f}')
